When it comes to wildfires, response time matters. We must do more to protect our communities, ranches, and farms. Nebraska experienced devastating losses due to historic wildfires this year. 

The PREPARE Act would ensure aerial firefighting resources are ready to respond before fire strikes. It would limit response time and prevent damages to our farms, livestock, and communities.
